card.name: York after New; pre-existing; Winthrop
card.fires_on: The second part of a few fixed names or terms: "York" after "New" in New York University, "-existing" after "pre" in worsening of pre-existing conditions, and "throp" in Winthrop.

modes.label: New York University
modes.description: "York" right after "New" in the name of New York University or its medical center.
modes.example: Darrell S. Rigel, MD, clinical professor of dermatology, New<< York>> University.

modes.label: pre-existing condition
modes.description: The "existing" part of "pre-existing" in warnings about worsening of an existing disease.
modes.example: can lead to new onset of hypertension or worsening of pre<<-existing>> hypertension

modes.label: Winthrop hospital name
modes.description: "throp" completing the hospital name Winthrop after a doctor's affiliation.
